_comment: Ops Console Probe configuration (chmod 600). Replace hubUrl, nodeId, and token before starting.

_notes.hubUrl: Base URL of your Ops Console hub (e.g. https://hub.example.ts.net or http://100.64.0.10:4320). Probe sends POST <hubUrl>/api/probes/ingest.
_notes.nodeId: Unique node identifier registered on the hub (e.g. edge-node-01, macbook-pro-01).
_notes.token: Per-node scoped bearer token issued by the hub. Can also be provided via OPS_PROBE_TOKEN.
_notes.deviceType: Device role: hub, server, edge, laptop, mobile, or auto.
_notes.intervalSec: Telemetry push interval in seconds (5 to 3600, default 30).
_notes.mounts: Filesystem mount paths to measure via df (each must start with '/').
_notes.watchServices: Explicit allowlist of services to check. Linux accepts unit names ('docker.service') or { name, scope: 'system'|'user' }. macOS accepts { name: 'Tailscale', port: 41641 } (localhost TCP probe) or { name: 'com.example.agent', launchd: true }.
